tools.name: taxcompare
tools.description: Compare annual gross, net pay, taxes, and employee social contributions across two or more supported countries. Use shared_gross for the same offer and local_median_gross for country-market benchmarks. Provide tax_year and at least two countries. Use berechne for detailed single-country payroll.
